mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy shift, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.3% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.3%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 315) and restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signal an aggressive central bank response to inflation, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where both CPIAUCSL exceeds 315 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market expansion (HOUST > 1300) reflects strong consumer demand for durable goods and housing, boosting corporate revenues and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where HOUST exceeds 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals weakening manufacturing activity and potential economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer credit demand (RSAFS > 700,000) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates robust household spending power, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where RSAFS exceeds 700,000 and UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 315) triggers central bank hawkishness, increasing real interest rates and equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 315.
